title: Fat with the fat of kidneys of wheat
html_source:
A reference to a transgression God scolds the Israelites for in Deuteronomy 32:14.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: From joyceproject:

It’s effect is to satirize the hypocrisy of priests, eating well while they promote poverty among their parishioners. The image of burly, fat, oily priests coheres with a strain of anti-clericalism that runs through Joyce’s works.
